title: Generalised Symmetries and Manifest Duality II: Curved Spacetime
summary: We extend the potential-based formulation of self-dual and duality-symmetric gauge theories developed in \cite{Chakrabarti:2025gyt} to curved spacetime. The gravitational coupling is encoded by the same metric-dependent linear map of Sen's formalism. The parent new action retains the higher-form $h$-gauge symmetry, and different gauge choices reproduce either Sen's flux-based formulation or a potential-based description in which the shadow sector decouples directly at the level of the action. We also derive explicit form of the gravitational map for the toroidally reduced theory in $D=4n$…
